deckTitle: Physiology Wrestling: Life-Force Logic & Homeostatic Heavyweights

cards.power: The Foundation-Charge. Creates the Potential-Energy-Reservoir.
cards.lore: Primary active transport. Maintains concentration gradient to power secondary moves.
cards.gradeReason: Gorilla pumping ions out of a vault — zero ambiguity, maximum embodiment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark watercolor. Subject: Armored gorilla pumping Na+/K+ ions through vault door. Mood: Unstoppable industrial power.

cards.power: The Voltage-Verdict. Defines the precise Balance-Point for a single ion.
cards.lore: Defines the Target-Voltage that each ion strives to reach when its gate opens.
cards.gradeReason: Owl wizard with scales is evocative but Nernst equation in STAT adds abstraction layer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Mystical watercolor. Subject: Owl wizard holding lightning-charged scales with ion concentrations. Mood: Precise, arcane.

cards.power: The Osmotic-Rush. Opens water-gates to equalize Concentration-Stats.
cards.lore: Facilitated diffusion of water. Responds to osmotic pressure.
cards.gradeReason: Octopus surging through water gates — osmotic rush is immediately physical and performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Fluid watercolor. Subject: Octopus as surging tidal wave bursting through membrane pore gates. Mood: Unstoppable, rushing.

cards.power: The Ready-Stance. Keeps the Cell-Engine idling, poised to strike.
cards.lore: Weighted average of all conductances, dominated by E-Leak-Channels.
cards.gradeReason: Sloth at rest is clever but resting potential as a performative action is inherently passive.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Electric watercolor. Subject: Armored sloth idling on a charged coil, K+ leaking around it. Mood: Tense stillness.

cards.power: The Signal-Ignition. Triggers a massive Voltage-Explosion.
cards.lore: Positive feedback loop. Opening voltage-gated Na+ channels flips the charge to positive.
cards.gradeReason: Electric eel wave explosion — Signal-Ignition is the most immediately explosive card in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Explosive watercolor. Subject: Electric eel surfing a voltage wave with Na+ ions erupting. Mood: Explosive, chain-reaction.

cards.power: The Reset-Wave. Drags the charge back to Resting-State.
cards.lore: Delayed-rectifier K+ channels unlock the cell so it can fire again.
cards.gradeReason: Walrus blowing K+ ions out in purple cool-wave — Reset-Wave is immediately embodied.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cool watercolor. Subject: Walrus exhaling purple K+ efflux wave over scorched membrane. Mood: Deliberate, resetting.

cards.power: The Jump-Move. Forces the Electric-Strike to jump gaps at lightning speed.
cards.lore: Increases membrane resistance, decreases capacitance.
cards.gradeReason: Space-suited cheetah jumping node-to-node — Jump-Move is pure kinetic performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sci-fi watercolor. Subject: Armored cheetah leaping between glowing Nodes of Ranvier at light speed. Mood: Velocity, precision.

cards.power: The Squeeze-Trigger. Unlocks the Actin-Myosin-Handshake.
cards.lore: Removes Tropomyosin-Shield so Myosin-Power-Stroke can begin.
cards.gradeReason: Frog with key unlocking muscle vault — Squeeze-Trigger is visceral and immediately physical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Vivid watercolor. Subject: Glowing frog inserting calcium key into troponin lock on muscle fiber. Mood: Decisive, unlocking.

cards.power: The Snap-Back. The more you stretch the Heart-Engine, the harder it snaps shut.
cards.lore: Increased stretch optimizes Actin-Myosin overlap for stronger contraction.
cards.gradeReason: Snap-Back is kinetic but 'Law' in the name signals a principle rather than a character to inhabit.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dynamic watercolor. Subject: Kangaroo stretching flaming heart-muscle to maximum tension, coiled to snap. Mood: Elastic, powerful.

cards.power: The Rhythm-Master. Fires a constant Electric-Pulse to dictate match speed.
cards.lore: Spontaneous depolarization via slow Na+ leak until Fire-Threshold is reached.
cards.gradeReason: Woodpecker firing rhythmic electric pulses — Rhythm-Master is the purest conductor character in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Neon watercolor. Subject: Glowing electric woodpecker drumming rhythmic pulses into heart muscle wall. Mood: Steady, inexorable.

cards.power: The Fuel-Pressure. Determines Blood-Fuel in the engine before the squeeze.
cards.lore: End-diastolic filling volume driven by venous tone and total Fluid-Volume.
cards.gradeReason: Elephant filling a tank is clear, but what to DO as Pre-Load requires cardiac output context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Industrial watercolor. Subject: Elephant trunk-filling a pressure tank before heart contraction. Mood: Building tension, filling.

cards.power: The Exit-Resistance. The heavy door the heart must push against.
cards.lore: Pressure overcome to eject blood via vasoconstriction.
cards.gradeReason: Rhino crashing a blood-splattered reinforced door — Exit-Resistance is immediately, viscerally physical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Impact watercolor. Subject: Rhino charging into a cracking vault door with blood-pressure spray. Mood: Brutal resistance.

cards.power: The Quick-Stabilizer. Sends Emergency-Signal to Clench-the-Vessels and Speed-the-Heart.
cards.lore: Decreased stretch = decreased firing = increased Sympathetic output (Fight-Move).
cards.gradeReason: Meerkat on watchtower sending emergency lightning signals — sentry role is instantly embodied.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Alert watercolor. Subject: Meerkat on carotid sentry tower firing emergency signal bolts to heart and vessels. Mood: Vigilant, urgent.

cards.power: The Volume-Restorer. A Hormone-Symphony to save salt/water and Clench-the-Pipes.
cards.lore: Angio II is the Vessel-Squeezer; Aldo is the Salt-Hoarder.
cards.gradeReason: Two-headed dragon cascade is epic but Renin→Angio→Aldo three-step requires hormone context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Epic watercolor. Subject: Twin-headed dragon breathing fire and salt over kidney pipes. Mood: Long-game domination.

cards.power: The Pressure-Buffer. Holds massive blood volumes without Pressure spikes.
cards.lore: Veins act as Volume-Buffers; Arteries act as Pressure-Pipes.
cards.gradeReason: Pufferfish bloating is charming but 'compliance' as a performable action stays abstract.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Soft watercolor. Subject: Bloated pufferfish expanding to absorb blood volume without bursting. Mood: Passive absorption, buffer.

cards.power: The Radius-Rule. A tiny squeeze causes a massive Resistance-Jump.
cards.lore: Doubling radius increases flow 16-fold. Radius is the Ultimate-Lever.
cards.gradeReason: Boa constrictor choking a pipe is viscerally immediate — Radius-Rule lands without any formula needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Tense watercolor. Subject: Boa constrictor coiling around pipe, trickling flow from tiny opening. Mood: Leverage, constriction.

cards.power: The Fresh-Air-Swap. Ensures Fresh-Oxygen-Tokens reach the Exchange-Surface.
cards.lore: Effective ventilation subtracts Dead-Space air from each breath.
cards.gradeReason: Fresh-Air-Swap is clear but the dead-space subtraction formula in STAT adds necessary context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pink watercolor. Subject: Inflating pink pufferfish alveolus in capillary web exchanging oxygen tokens. Mood: Essential, rhythmic.

cards.power: The Balloon-Support. Biological-Lubricant prevents tiny balloons from snapping shut.
cards.lore: Law of Laplace. Prevents small alveoli from collapsing into large ones.
cards.gradeReason: Bat hanging in glowing collapse-proof bubble — Balloon-Support is viscerally clear, no context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Glowing watercolor. Subject: Bat suspended in shimmering surfactant bubble preventing alveolar collapse. Mood: Protective, delicate.

cards.power: The Gas-Bridge. Determines how fast gases Jump-the-Gap.
cards.lore: The Oxygen-Jump fails if Membrane-Wall gets too thick (Fibrosis).
cards.gradeReason: Chameleon on diffusion surface is elegant but the flux formula in STAT anchors it to math.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Scientific watercolor. Subject: Chameleon striding across thin membrane bridge ferrying oxygen bubbles. Mood: Precise, calculated.

cards.power: The Oxygen-Unloader. Forces Hemoglobin-Trucks to drop oxygen in hot, acidic arenas.
cards.lore: Acidosis reduces Hb grip, delivering O2 to working muscles.
cards.gradeReason: Bull forcing hemoglobin to release oxygen in fire-and-acid arena — Oxygen-Unloader is perfection.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Fiery watercolor. Subject: Red bull breathing acid-fire to force open oxygen crates in scorched muscle arena. Mood: Strategic, brutal.

cards.power: The Trash-Filter. Determines Flow-Rate of the Waste-Stream.
cards.lore: Driven by Hydrostatic-Pressure pushing fluid through Fenestrated-Slits.
cards.gradeReason: Beaver/hamster as trash-filter king in the waste stream — role is crystal clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gritty watercolor. Subject: Gopher-king manning glomerular filter dam against torrent of waste fluid. Mood: Decisive, industrial.

cards.power: The Resource-Saver. Snatches Gold-Tokens back before they hit the Urine-Exit.
cards.lore: Mass-bulk reabsorption driven by Sodium-Cotransport-Moves.
cards.gradeReason: Raccoon snatching glucose gold off conveyor belt before urine exit — pure heist energy, G1 no question.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Heist watercolor. Subject: Raccoon snatching glucose coins off tubule conveyor belt at vault entrance. Mood: Quick, opportunistic.

cards.power: The Salt-Trap. Builds a massive Salty-Desert to pull water out later.
cards.lore: Ascending/descending permeability rules build an osmotic gradient.
cards.gradeReason: Camel building a salt desert — Salt-Trap is the most evocative kidney metaphor in any MedKayfab deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Desert watercolor. Subject: Camel trudging through salt canyon, depositing NaCl layers to build osmotic gradient. Mood: Patient, strategic.

cards.power: The Volume-Lock. Commands Distal-Pipes to drag water back via salt.
cards.lore: Increases ENaC-Channels to boost sodium reabsorption and blood volume.
cards.gradeReason: Golden armadillo hoarding salt at vault door — Volume-Lock character identity is ironclad.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Golden watercolor. Subject: Armored armadillo guarding distal tubule vault, hoarding salt behind sealed door. Mood: Possessive, commanding.

cards.power: The Acid-Soaker. Catches Proton-Acid-Darts before they burn the Enzyme-Gears.
cards.lore: Henderson-Hasselbalch system working with lungs and kidneys to keep pH 7.4.
cards.gradeReason: Blue turtle deflecting red acid arrows — Acid-Soaker defensive role is immediately physical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Defensive watercolor. Subject: Blue turtle shell deflecting red H+ acid darts in enzyme battlefield. Mood: Steadfast, protective.

cards.power: The Rapid-Acidifier. If Lung-Balloons stall, CO2 crashes the pH in minutes.
cards.lore: CO2 + H2O ↔ H2CO3. CO2 is a volatile acid.
cards.gradeReason: Green toad sitting in acid pool — villain card, Rapid-Acidifier is immediately menacing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Toxic watercolor. Subject: Bloated green toad oozing carbonic acid into blood pool with melting pH. Mood: Toxic, fast-acting threat.

cards.power: The Poison-Detector. Spots a Hidden-Acid-Saboteur in the ring.
cards.lore: Law of Electroneutrality; represents unmeasured anions balancing the charge.
cards.gradeReason: Poison-Detector panther is strong but Mystery-Math in the name frontloads formula anxiety.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Noir watercolor. Subject: Black panther leaping over unmeasured anion void between H+ and HCO3- cliffs. Mood: Detective, calculating.

cards.power: The Slow-Cleanup. The Long-Match to pee out acid.
cards.lore: Metabolic compensation takes 2-3 days to counter-move a respiratory attack.
cards.gradeReason: Slow-Cleanup badger is apt but 'slow' and '2-3 days' make this the least dramatic card in the acid section.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gritty watercolor. Subject: Two badgers forging HCO3- at anvil while sweeping H+ into drain tunnel. Mood: Grinding, methodical.

cards.power: The Sugar-Vault. Opens GLUT-Gates to move Sugar-Tokens into storage.
cards.lore: Fed-state commander; promotes lipogenesis and glycogen synthesis.
cards.gradeReason: Bear unlocking ice vault to stash sugar cubes — Sugar-Vault is immediately embodied, fed-state hero.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cold watercolor. Subject: Bear with golden keys opening GLUT-gate vault stuffed with glucose cubes. Mood: Possessive, decisive.

cards.power: The Energy-Release. Raids the Liver-Vault to flood blood with Energy-Tokens.
cards.lore: Fast-state commander; the eternal nemesis to Insu.
cards.gradeReason: Fox torching liver-vault to release glucose — eternal nemesis energy lands immediately at any table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Fiery watercolor. Subject: Wiry fox blasting liver-vault with flamethrower, glucose cubes flooding bloodstream. Mood: Raiding, urgent.

cards.power: The Long-Term-Survival. Prepares for a Long-Siege, blunting the Immune-Riot.
cards.lore: Prioritizes current survival over future repair (causes tissue wasting).
cards.gradeReason: Turtle with satellite dish in flames is great but the trade-off complexity needs context to embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Siege watercolor. Subject: Helmeted turtle monitoring burning immune battlefield while tissue begins to waste. Mood: Grimly pragmatic.

cards.power: The Metabolic-Speed. Determines how fast Cell-Engines run.
cards.lore: Revs up system metabolism by increasing Vault-Keepers and Beta-Receptors.
cards.gradeReason: Hummingbird cranking SYSTEM VELOCITY throttle dial to max — nobody doubts what to perform here.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Energetic watercolor. Subject: Hummingbird cranking flaming throttle dial labeled SYSTEM VELOCITY to maximum. Mood: Accelerating, frenetic.

cards.power: The Fire-Starter. Commands Stomach-Pits to pour out Acid-Fire.
cards.lore: Activates Proton-Pump-Engine (H+/K+ ATPase).
cards.gradeReason: Hyena pouring green acid fire into churning stomach — best villain card in the GI section, instant G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Toxic watercolor. Subject: Cackling hyena in apron flooding stomach pits with neon-green acid fire. Mood: Malicious, igniting.

cards.power: The Bile-Release. Squeezes Gallbladder-Sponge to spray Bile-Detergent.
cards.lore: Slows stomach emptying so the small intestine isn't overwhelmed.
cards.gradeReason: Snake coiling and squeezing gallbladder sponge to jet bile — Squeezer role is viscerally immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Slimy watercolor. Subject: Green snake coiling gallbladder sponge to spray yellow bile-detergent at fat globules. Mood: Constricting, decisive.

cards.power: The Fire-Extinguisher. Tells Pancreas-Factory to spray Bicarb-Shields.
cards.lore: Nature's antacid; protects intestinal wallpaper from Gastri's fire.
cards.gradeReason: Dalmatian firefighter hosing down acid fire with bicarb — perfect reactive hero, instantly performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Emergency watercolor. Subject: Dalmatian firefighter blasting HCO3- foam over duodenal acid flames from hose. Mood: Urgent, protective.

cards.power: The Vitamin-Bodyguard. Protects B12 from Acid-Vandals.
cards.lore: Lack of escort destroys B12, causing Macro-Max-Anemia and nerve melt.
cards.gradeReason: Wolf in armor carrying B12 through acid territory — Vitamin-Bodyguard role requires no explanation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Armored watercolor. Subject: Wolf in full plate armor escorting glowing blue B12 molecule through acid-vandal gauntlet. Mood: Protective, fierce.

cards.power: The Oxygen-Courier. Folds and squeezes to carry Oxygen-Crates.
cards.lore: Navigates narrow Capillary-Alleys to supply the Muscle-Arena.
cards.gradeReason: Red crab folding to squeeze through capillary alley with oxygen spheres — courier role is crystalline.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cellular watercolor. Subject: Red crab squeezing biconcave body through capillary alley carrying oxygen crates. Mood: Determined, essential.

cards.power: The Temporary-Plug. Throws Platelet-Bricks into the hole.
cards.lore: vWF is the glue linking bricks to the damaged collagen walls.
cards.gradeReason: Beaver throwing platelet bricks into bleeding breach — nothing more immediate than plugging a hole.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Emergency watercolor. Subject: Beaver hurling golden platelet-bricks into gushing vascular breach in collagen wall. Mood: Frantic, urgent.

cards.power: The Permanent-Seal. Turns the Temporary-Plug into solid Armor-Clot.
cards.lore: Thrombin converts Fibrinogen to a solid Fibrin web.
cards.gradeReason: Spider spinning fibrin web over platelet bricks — Permanent-Seal construction metaphor is flawless G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gothic watercolor. Subject: Giant spider weaving fibrin web over golden platelet-brick plug in bloodied wound. Mood: Methodical, final.

cards.power: The Arena-Cleanup. Eats the web so the Blood-Flow-Highway is clear.
cards.lore: Digests fibrin. Too slow = Clot-Monster (Thrombosis) blocks the road.
cards.gradeReason: Mantis cutting fibrin web for highway clearance — Arena-Cleanup is the deck's best closer card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Clinical watercolor. Subject: Praying mantis slicing fibrin web apart to reopen blood-flow highway. Mood: Precise, clearing.

cards.power: The Invisible-Map. Tells Brain-Bunker exactly where limbs are in space.
cards.lore: Essential for Balance-and-Coordination-Moves.
cards.gradeReason: Blindfolded lemur on tightrope in holographic grid is evocative but proprioception as action is abstract.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Holographic watercolor. Subject: Blindfolded lemur balancing on tightrope inside glowing 3D positional grid. Mood: Invisible sense, precise.

cards.power: The Damage-Signal. Screams FIRE! when Arena-Walls are crushed.
cards.lore: Transforms tissue-trauma into electrical-panic.
cards.gradeReason: Porcupine shooting lightning bolts at angry brain — Screams FIRE is the most visceral one-liner in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Electric watercolor. Subject: Porcupine firing pain-lightning at furious brain receiver above crushed tissue. Mood: Screaming alarm, urgent.

cards.power: The Gravity-Anchor. Detects if the Arena is tilting or spinning.
cards.lore: Fluid moving over hair-cells detects rotation and tilt.
cards.gradeReason: Goat on vinyl turntable with goggles is inventive but vestibular 'detecting' isn't immediately performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dizzy watercolor. Subject: Helmeted goat riding spinning turntable, semicircular canals glowing as otoliths shift. Mood: Gyroscopic, sensing.

cards.power: The Arena-State-Selector. Selects Combat-Mode vs Recovery-Mode.
cards.lore: Antagonistic balancing of involuntary systems to match environment stress.
cards.gradeReason: Fire-tiger vs water-tiger split — Combat-Mode/Recovery-Mode selector is the clearest dual-state card in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Yin-yang watercolor. Subject: Tiger split down middle — fire-and-storm left half vs calm-water right half. Mood: Binary, decisive.

cards.power: The Master-Drummer. Tells Pituitary-Guards when to release hormones.
cards.lore: If the pulse is steady instead of rhythmic, the lifecycle engine stalls.
cards.gradeReason: Raven conducting pulsatile waves from mixing board — Master-Drummer conducting reproductive timing is pure G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cosmic watercolor. Subject: Raven conductor sending pulsatile hormone waves to pituitary guards with baton. Mood: Commanding, rhythmic.

cards.power: The Egg-Launch. Forces the Egg-Knight to burst out.
cards.lore: The mid-cycle surge forces ovulation; in males, stimulates Testo.
cards.gradeReason: Golden ram as asteroid blasting through ovarian wall — Egg-Launch is the most explosive reproductive card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Explosive cosmic watercolor. Subject: Golden ram-comet blasting through ovarian wall at mid-cycle surge. Mood: Explosive, unstoppable.

cards.power: The Growth-Nurturer. Waters the seeds for Follicle-Knights.
cards.lore: Helps eggs and sperm mature for the biological match.
cards.gradeReason: Doe watering follicle-bubbles is lovely but Growth-Nurturer is the least wrestling-ready verb in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gentle watercolor. Subject: Silver doe watering glowing follicle-bubbles in moonlit forest. Mood: Nurturing, patient.

cards.power: The Birth-Push. Causes uterine walls to clench and milk letdown.
cards.lore: Links physical squeezing-action to social bonding.
cards.gradeReason: Python squeezing pink uterus-jug releasing colorful spheres — Birth-Push is the most viscerally immediate reproductive card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Lush watercolor. Subject: Python squeezing pink uterine vessel, colorful hormone spheres erupting upward. Mood: Powerful, intimate.

cards.power: The Temp-Governor. Monitors Blood-Temperature to trigger Shakes or Floods.
cards.lore: Pyrogen-the-Fire-Starter triggers Fever-Move by turning up the dial.
cards.gradeReason: Iguana at control panel with thermometer cranking fans or heaters — Temp-Governor is exactly what you'd perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Control-room watercolor. Subject: Iguana operator at temperature console with thermometer, triggering fans and heat banks. Mood: Precise governor.

cards.power: The Liquid-Coolant. Evaporates Heat-Tokens into the air.
cards.lore: The most effective cooling move; fails if humidity-stat is too high.
cards.gradeReason: Dolphin dripping blue cooling waves — Liquid-Coolant is the most efficient cooling character, instantly clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cool watercolor. Subject: Dolphin arcing through air, leaving blue evaporation trail absorbing heat-tokens. Mood: Refreshing, efficient.

cards.power: The Emergency-Warmth. Forces muscles to twitch for friction-heat.
cards.lore: Inefficient for movement, highly efficient for thermal energy.
cards.gradeReason: Chihuahua shaking with fire sparks — Emergency-Warmth is the most immediately physical thermoregulation card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Frantic watercolor. Subject: Shaking chihuahua generating sparks and heat through rapid muscle twitching. Mood: Desperate warmth.

cards.power: The Peripheral-Shutdown. Clamps surface-pipes to prevent radiative heat loss.
cards.lore: Keeps Warm-Blood-Tokens safe at the price of icy hands.
cards.gradeReason: Penguin with inner fire glow clamping skin pipes — Peripheral-Shutdown at the price of icy hands is perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Cold/warm contrast watercolor. Subject: Penguin glowing with inner fire while skin surface ices over in arctic cold. Mood: Sacrificial protection.

cards.power: The System-Stabilizer.
cards.lore: Respect the set-point! Check pressure, check pH, and follow the flow!
cards.gradeReason: FrizzleBob as system-master holding it all together — URGENT stamp makes this the only card you immediately salute.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Chaotic watercolor. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit in lab coat pointing at body diagram with URGENT stamp. Mood: Commanding chaos-manager.

cards.power: Link Bohr-the-Shift (drops O2 to tissues) and Renal-the-Acid-Excreter (compensates for hyperventilation blow-off).
cards.lore: 5000m altitude. Low O2.
cards.gradeReason: Mountain-Climb scenario is vivid but requires card-linking mechanic context to execute.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Mountain watercolor. Subject: Muscular goat climbing snowy 5000m peak against low-oxygen storm. Mood: Grueling, adaptive.

cards.power: Trigger the RAAS-Dragon to squeeze pipes and Aldo-the-Armadillo to lock down the salt/water vault.
cards.lore: Fluid-loss, dropping BP.
cards.gradeReason: Desert-Run crisis is evocative but RAAS-Dragon activation chain requires table orchestration.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Desert watercolor. Subject: Lizard sprinting across scorching sand dunes while BP gauges drop. Mood: Crisis, dehydration.

cards.power: Gluca-the-Fox raids the liver-vault; Corti-the-Turtle blunts tissue repair to survive the siege.
cards.lore: 24-hr fast. Sugar-Stat 60.
cards.gradeReason: Sugar-Crash scenario links two strong characters cleanly but still requires multi-card activation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark cave watercolor. Subject: Gaunt bear huddled in cave as bats circle, hypoglycemia shadows closing in. Mood: Siege survival.

verdict: FrizzleBob fires on all 56 cylinders — from gorilla ion-pumps to python birth-pushes, every character embodies a physiological truth without needing an explanation placard. Named strength: the animal-persona naming convention ('Gastri-the-Acid-Igniter', 'Plasm-the-Clot-Dissolver') hits the precise sweet spot between mnemonic and performative. Named weakness: Quest cards need sharper POWER text to read as arena-ready moves rather than clinical instructions. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: For med students who need physiology to stick — 56 larger-than-life characters from the Na/K vault-keeper gorilla to the RAAS dragon, each one a mnemonic that moves. Maximum FrizzleBob. Zero boring.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — FrizzleBob front-center in lab coat with clipboard, surrounded by mechanical organ systems, gears, pressure gauges, and bug mechanics; maximum energy density
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — MEDKAYFAB PHYSIOLOGY WRESTLING: LIFE-FORCE LOGIC & HOMEOSTATIC HEAVYWEIGHTS — full punch, no wasted syllables
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — Tagline 'Protect the Set-Point. Master the Loop. Stay Fluffy!' captures the deck's tone with surgical precision
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — FrizzleBob-as-physiologist with bug mechanics crew is distinctive within the MedKayfab series
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — Eye-catching for med students and science nerds; cartoon-chaos aesthetic will stop thumbs on TikTok
coverQA.coverNote: One of the strongest covers in the MedKayfab series — the 'CALL DOC FRIZZLE!' speech bubble in the top-right is a killer recurring hook. 'MEDKAYFABE!' in the bottom-left grounds it in brand. The gear-and-organ industrial aesthetic is immediately legible even at thumbnail size.

notes: Standard 2x2 grid, 14 story pages x 4 cards = 56 cards. Last page (p.15) contains 1 meta-character card (The Physiological Attending / Doc FrizzleBob) plus 3 Quest/Scenario cards (Mountain-Climb, Desert-Run, Sugar-Crash) — a novel game mechanic for the MedKayfab series. Quest cards use APPROVED/URGEVED stamps (Quest 2 stamp reads 'URGEVED', likely a portmanteau of URGENT+APPROVED — possible rendering artifact or intentional). One possible font rendering artifact on p.10 Gastri card POWER text ('Cemmands' vs 'Commands'). System coverage is comprehensive and sequenced: cellular physiology → cardiac → vascular → respiratory → renal → acid-base → endocrine (metabolic, GI, reproductive, stress) → hematology → neurosensory → thermoregulation. No RAF dice boxes present. Cross-referencing between cards (Aldo appears in both RAAS and renal sections) shows intentional system-linking design.

urgent: Rename 'Anion-Gap-the-Mystery-Math' — 'Mystery-Math' front-loads formula anxiety; try 'Anion-Gap-the-Hidden-Saboteur' to match Poison-Detector POWER
Quest card POWER fields need performative verb framing ('ACTIVATE: Link Bohr...' rather than plain instructions)
quickWins: Add APPROVED/URGENT stamp consistency — Quest 2 reads 'URGEVED' (likely typo); standardize stamp text across all three quest cards
Consider adding a POWER line to Quest cards matching the X-the-Y-Z card format for table-flow consistency
niceToHave: Two more villain/antagonist cards (beyond CO2-the-Respiratory-Acid and Gastri-the-Acid-Igniter) would add combat drama in the vascular/renal sections
The Physiological Attending (Doc FrizzleBob) as a recurring master-card across all MedKayfab decks would create a powerful cross-deck identity
